title: Brits Watch 44 Movies or Shows in Bed a Year
paragraphs: A bed is more than somewhere to sleep, with many people using theirs to relax with books, maybe snacks — and, of course, television shows and movies!
In fact, according to a survey for mattress company Silentnight of 2,000 British adults, people in the UK watch an average of 44 movies or television shows a year from bed.

Twenty-three percent of survey participants also said they like reading books in bed — while 20% said they like cuddling up with their partner. Fifteen percent said they just like some quiet relaxation in bed.
With the UK known as a nation of tea drinkers, it's no surprise that an average of 103 cups of tea are enjoyed by the average person in bed every year — as are 18 breakfasts.
Bedroom dining isn't without its dangers, though — an average of nine food or drink spills happen in a year too.
Why do people use their beds for so many things that aren't sleeping?

Well, maybe it's because, for 57% of people, their bedroom is the place where they feel most relaxed and comfortable. Almost one-third of participants said they'd be happy to spend a whole day in bed if they could!
Sleep historian Sasha Handley from The University of Manchester explained that beds have always been used for more than sleeping, being places to read, recover from being sick or just talk.

"What we sleep on has changed, but throughout that journey, the bed has remained a place of comfort, care and retreat, with individual rituals turning a bed from somewhere we sleep into a space that feels like our own," she said.
However, there's still some disagreement about how beds should be used for pets. While 16% of participants said they welcome pets in their beds, 31% are completely against it!
